scope: independent CPU recomputation; no fresh stochastic run

statistical_review.simpson: Keep Toys/Beauty separate; no pooled average used to declare a winner.
statistical_review.ecological: Per-domain means do not imply all users benefit.
statistical_review.berkson: Historical development512 samples reused; no population extrapolation.
statistical_review.collider: No subgroup conditioning or causal adjustment introduced.
statistical_review.base_rate: All512 users retained; gained/lost top10 counts preserved.
statistical_review.regression_to_mean: Adaptation is matched, but following disappointing replacements can invite winner selection; remains exploratory.
statistical_review.survivorship: Every prespecified arm and all512 users completed; saved prefixes retained.
statistical_review.look_elsewhere: Many comparisons, uncorrected descriptive intervals; no confirmatory significance claim.
statistical_review.forking_paths: Scientific configuration frozen; resource changes audited; same dev pool used repeatedly.
statistical_review.causation: This controlled pipeline comparison does not establish time-information utility or alpha as sole cause.
statistical_review.reverse_causality: Inputs remain history-only; target appears only in training objective/evaluation.
